title: Gram determinant of two linear functionals restricted to a 2-plane (Lagrange identity + Parseval)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, T a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim T = 2, (u_i)_{i ∈ Fin(dim T)} := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T (vectors of T viewed in ℝ^P), p_T := T.starProjection, and p, q ∈ ℝ^P. Let G be the dim T × dim T matrix G_ij := ⟨p,u_i⟩⟨p,u_j⟩ + ⟨q,u_i⟩⟨q,u_j⟩. Then det G = |p_T p|²·|p_T q|² − ⟨p_T p, p_T q⟩².
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p q : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ T = 2 → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ T) => inner ℝ p (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i : Euclid P) * inner ℝ p (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j : Euclid P) + inner ℝ q (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i : Euclid P) * inner ℝ q (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j : Euclid P)) = ‖T.starProjection p‖ ^ 2 * ‖T.starProjection q‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (T.starProjection p) (T.starProjection q) ^ 2
